info.name: EverDigitech Client API
info.description: Client panel API (Laravel + Sanctum SPA cookies, origin localhost:3002). Run 'Auth > 1. Get CSRF cookie', then Register or Login. Import the environment file too. Postman shares cookies per host, so you can stay signed in to the admin and the client collection at the same time. See docs/API.md. Continue with Google needs a Google ID token pasted into googleCredential (see that request).

exec: // Sanctum SPA auth: requests must come from a stateful origin (the client panel), and writes carry the XSRF cookie in X-XSRF-TOKEN.
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-XSRF-TOKEN', value: fromCookie ? decodeURIComponent(raw) : raw });
console.warn('NO XSRF TOKEN. Run "Auth > 1. Get CSRF cookie" first, then send this request again.');

request.description: Is the API up? Needs no sign-in.
Public, no sign-in. Hidden groups and products are left out. Every price is {net, tax, total} in paisa, worked out with the tax setting.

exec: const d = (pm.response.json() || {}).data || {}; pm.test('has a tax setting and groups', () => { pm.expect(d.tax).to.have.keys(['label', 'rate', 'inclusive']); pm.expect(d.groups).to.be.an('array'); });

request.description: ?group=<slug of the group>.
Sets the XSRF-TOKEN and session cookies. Run once before Register or Login, and again after a 419.

Signs the person in and sends a verification email (written to storage/logs/laravel.log, or sent by the queue worker). 5 per hour per IP. Locally the captcha is skipped when TURNSTILE_SECRET is empty.
Errors: 422 invalid_credentials, 429 account_locked, 403 account_suspended. A new browser triggers a "new sign-in" email.

item.name: Continue with Google (paste the credential first)

request.description:
Signs in, or signs up, with a Google account. Body: {"credential": "<Google ID token>"}.

Needs GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in the API .env (same id as NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID on the website).

HOW TO GET A CREDENTIAL (Postman cannot show the Google popup):
1. Open http://localhost:3002/login in the browser, open DevTools > Network (tick Preserve log).
2. Click 'Continue with Google' and pick an account.
3. Find the request 'google' (POST .../api/client/google). In its Payload tab copy the value of `credential`.
4. Paste it into the collection variable googleCredential and send this request within a few minutes: the token expires after about an hour, and a token the website already used still works (it is not one-time).

Results: 201 new client created, 200 signed in. Errors: 422 invalid_google_token, 403 account_suspended / account_closed, 409 google_account_mismatch, 502 google_unreachable (PHP curl.cainfo), 503 google_not_configured.

exec: pm.test('signed in (200) or signed up (201)', () => pm.expect([200, 201]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('email is verified by Google', () => pm.expect(d.user && d.user.email_verified).to.equal(true));

request.description: Includes `impersonation` ({admin_name, started_at, expires_at}) while staff are signed in as this client; null otherwise.
Signs out the client guard only (also ends an impersonation).
Copy the four values from the link in the email: {CLIENT_APP_URL}/verify-email?id=..&hash=..&expires=..&signature=.. and put them in the collection variables.
1 per minute, 6 per hour.
Always the same answer. 3 per email per hour (429 after that). The link {CLIENT_APP_URL}/reset-password?token=..&email=.. is in storage/logs/laravel.log.
Token from the email link, valid 60 minutes, one use. Signs out every session. 422 invalid_reset_token if wrong or used.
Wrong current password: 422 on current_password. Signs out the other devices. After a successful change set the environment clientPassword to the new value.
A new phone number clears phone_verified. Add "remove_avatar": true to remove the picture.
Choose a jpg, png or webp file (max 2 MB). It is resized to 256x256. Run `php artisan storage:link` once so the avatar_url works.
A link goes to the NEW address; the current email stays active until it is confirmed. 3 per hour.

item.name: Confirm email change (values from the link)

request.description: Values from {CLIENT_APP_URL}/confirm-email-change?id=..&hash=..&expires=..&signature=.. No sign-in needed. Errors: invalid_email_change_link, email_change_link_expired, email_already_taken.
Keeps the current device.

item.name: Log in as client (from the admin panel)

request.description: First run "Clients > Log in as client" in the admin collection: it saves the token. The token works once, for 60 seconds. The session lasts 30 minutes.

item.name: Try to change the password while impersonating (403)

request.description: Expected: 403 not_allowed_while_impersonating (same for email change and deleting other sessions).

exec: pm.test('blocked while impersonating (or 422/401 when not impersonating)', () => pm.expect([403, 422, 401]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Signs out the client guard only. The admin sign-in stays. 403 not_impersonating for a normal client.
Owner only. Saves the first member id (not the owner) in memberId and the first invitation id in invitationId.

exec: const member = (d.members || []).find((m) => m.role !== 'owner'); if (member) pm.collectionVariables.set('memberId', member.id);

request.description: Owner only, needs a confirmed email. The email goes to the invited address (storage/logs/laravel.log with MAIL_MAILER=log; run the queue worker). Copy the token from the link {CLIENT_APP_URL}/accept-invite?token=.. into teamInviteToken. 7 days, one use.
A new link; the old one stops working.
Body can also be {"status": "suspended"} or {"status": "active"}. 403 owner_cannot_be_changed for the owner.
Sign in as the member first. 403 owner_cannot_leave for the owner.
Shows the account name and a masked email. 422 invalid_invitation when unknown, used or expired.
Sign in as the invited person first (same email, confirmed). 403 invitation_email_mismatch / email_not_verified, 422 invalid_invitation.

item.name: Live feed (new support replies since the cursor)

request.description: Run once without the after parameter to get the starting cursor, then again after staff reply to a ticket. `unread` is the number of tickets with a reply you have not opened. The dashboard does this every 20 seconds.
Saves the first department id in departmentId.
Needs a confirmed email and tickets.create. Saves the ticket id in ticketId. 10 an hour.

exec: const t = pm.response.json() || {}; if (t.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('ticketId', t.id);

item.name: Open a ticket with a file (multipart)

request.description: Choose a file (jpg, png, webp, pdf, txt, log, zip; 5 MB; up to 3). Add more attachments[] rows for more files.
status: all, open, answered, closed. meta.counts has the tab numbers.
Staff notes are never included.
Opens a closed or answered ticket again.
Set attachmentId from the thread (replies[].attachments[].id). Use Send and Download.
What we sell and what it costs, as net, tax and total. Needs no sign-in.

Up to 10 names. Availability comes from Dynadot (key in .env, server IP allowed in Dynadot). 503 registrar_not_configured without a key; 502 registrar_unavailable if Dynadot refuses (wrong key, IP not allowed). Answers are kept for 2 minutes.
{enabled, recovery_codes_left}.

The old codes stop working.

After Login answered 202 {two_factor_required: true}, in the same cookie session. Or send {"recovery_code": "xxxxx-xxxxx"}. 5 wrong codes or 5 minutes end it (422 two_factor_expired).
